page: Amazon Web Services r8i-flex.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 virtual CPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64, utilizing dedicated CPU allocation with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. The processor includes a substantial 480 MB L3 cache, alongside 48 KB L1d and 2 MB L2 caches. No local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU hardware is bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is established at a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong capabilities in both memory-intensive and compute-heavy tasks. The instance achieves top-tier performance in Geekbench single-core execution, software compilation with Clang, image processing, and text processing. Multi-core performance is also strong, as demonstrated by a Passmark CPU score of 82965.26 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 20357.0. Memory read bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 5122.92 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 192.31 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, though large block write bandwidth is moderate at 77.38 GB/sec. The inclusion of Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) supports accelerated operations, yielding 290.6 tokens/sec for medium-model LLM prompt processing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the r8i-flex.16xlarge offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads without the overhead of local storage. The absence of local SSDs represents a tradeoff, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data. This configuration is highly suitable for large-scale database operations, memory-resident caching layers like Redis, software compilation pipelines, and medium-scale language model inference.
description: Amazon Web Services r8i-flex.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance featuring 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz. Built on the Nitro hypervisor, it delivers 512.0 GB of high-speed 7 GHz DDR5 memory, translating to 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance lacks local storage and dedicated GPUs, relying on a 15 Gbps baseline network speed. Performance benchmarks show top-tier results in software compilation, text processing, and static web serving, alongside strong multi-core CPU and memory read bandwidth capabilities. Supported by Intel AMX and AVX-512 instruction sets, it is highly efficient for memory-intensive workloads. The r8i-flex.16xlarge is best suited for large databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise-grade web serving.
